test_case_info.test_case_title: Verify connection lost handling
test_case_info.pre_condition: A user (Teacher or Student) is logged in, enrolled in the course, and has joined an active video session with active video and chat services.
test_case_info.expected_result: The system attempts to reconnect to the services. If reconnection fails, the user is notified and prompted to rejoin the session.
test_case_info.post_condition: User is notified of connection loss and can attempt to rejoin the session.

test_steps.step: Simulate a network disconnection for the user's device.
User observes the system's attempt to reconnect to the video and chat services.
User observes a notification message indicating connection loss and potential need to rejoin the session (if reconnection fails).
Restore network connection.
User attempts to rejoin the session (if prompted).

uncovered_conditions: Exception: E1: Connection Lost (System attempts to reconnect, user notified if fails, user may need to rejoin)

test_case_info.path_step: User navigates to the calendar page when no sessions are scheduled for their enrolled courses.
test_case_info.test_scenario: Verify that the calendar page correctly displays as empty when the user has no scheduled sessions for any of their enrolled courses.
test_case_info.test_case_title: Display Empty Calendar for User with No Scheduled Sessions
test_case_info.pre_condition: A user (Student or Teacher) is logged in and enrolled in at least one course, but there are no sessions scheduled for any of their enrolled courses.
test_case_info.expected_result: The calendar is displayed, but it appears empty, indicating no scheduled sessions. The system should clearly convey that no sessions are planned.
test_case_info.post_condition: The user successfully views an empty calendar page.

test_steps.step: Log in as a user who is enrolled in at least one course but has no sessions scheduled for any of their enrolled courses.
Navigate to the 'Calendar' page from the Dashboard.
Verify that the calendar is displayed and clearly shows no scheduled sessions (e.g., an empty calendar view, a 'No Sessions' message).

uncovered_conditions: AF1: No Sessions

test_case_info.path_step: User attempts to view the calendar when the calendar service or database is unavailable.
test_case_info.test_scenario: Verify the system's behavior and error handling when the calendar service or database is temporarily unavailable during calendar access.
test_case_info.test_case_title: Handle Calendar Service Unavailable Error
test_case_info.pre_condition: A user is logged in. The backend calendar service or database is simulated to be unavailable prior to accessing the Calendar page.
test_case_info.expected_result: The system logs a critical error. The user is displayed a generic error message on the Calendar page (e.g., 'Calendar service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.'). The calendar content should not load.
test_case_info.post_condition: The user is informed of the system unavailability and critical error is logged.

test_steps.step: Log in as a valid user.
Simulate the calendar service or database becoming unavailable.
Navigate to the 'Calendar' page from the Dashboard.
Verify that an appropriate error message is displayed on the screen, indicating service unavailability (e.g., 'Calendar service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.').
Verify that a critical error is logged in the system's error logs.

uncovered_conditions: E1: System Unavailable

test_case_info.path_step: User attempts to view sessions for a course they are not enrolled in.
test_case_info.test_scenario: Verify that a user cannot see sessions for courses they are not enrolled in, adhering to the Session Visibility business rule (BR-CALENDAR-01).
test_case_info.test_case_title: Prevent Viewing Sessions for Unenrolled Courses
test_case_info.pre_condition: A user is logged in and enrolled in Course A (with scheduled sessions). Course B exists and has scheduled sessions, but the user is NOT enrolled in Course B.
test_case_info.expected_result: The user's calendar displays sessions only for Course A. Sessions for Course B are not visible on the calendar, upholding the session visibility rule.
test_case_info.post_condition: The user's calendar correctly reflects sessions only for enrolled courses, and non-enrolled course sessions are hidden.

test_steps.step: Log in as a user who is enrolled in Course A (with sessions) but not Course B (with sessions).
Navigate to the 'Calendar' page from the Dashboard.
Verify that the calendar displays scheduled sessions for Course A.
Verify that no scheduled sessions for Course B are visible on the calendar.

uncovered_conditions: BR-CALENDAR-01: Users can only see the sessions for the courses they are enrolled in (negative case)

test_case_info.path_step: User attempts to logout, but system fails to terminate session due to an internal error.
test_case_info.test_scenario: Verify the system's behavior when a logout attempt fails due to an internal system error, ensuring the user is notified and remains logged in.
test_case_info.test_case_title: Verify failed logout due to system error
test_case_info.pre_condition: A user (Teacher or Student) is successfully logged into the system and is currently on their Dashboard Page. The system is configured to simulate an internal error upon receiving a logout request (e.g., session termination service is unavailable or a database error occurs).
test_case_info.expected_result: The user remains on the Dashboard Page, and an informative error message (e.g., "Logout failed. Please try again later.") is displayed on the screen. The user's session is not terminated, and they remain authenticated.
test_case_info.post_condition: The user is still logged into the system and remains on the Dashboard Page, with an error message indicating the logout failure.

test_steps.step: Ensure the user is logged in and navigate to the Dashboard Page.
Click the 'Logout' button located in the navigation bar.
Observe the system's response and verify that the user is not redirected to the Landing Page.
Verify that an appropriate error message indicating logout failure is displayed on the current page.
Attempt to access a protected resource to confirm the user is still logged into the system.

test_data_fields.field_value: Simulate internal error on logout request
Logout failed. Please try again later.

uncovered_conditions: UC-COM-11 Postconditions: Failure
UC-COM-11 Expected Results: Upon failed logout

test_case_info.path_step: User initiates logout, system requests confirmation, and user cancels the logout request.
test_case_info.test_scenario: Verify that the system presents a confirmation dialog before logging out and that the user can successfully cancel the logout operation, remaining logged in.
test_case_info.test_case_title: Verify cancellation of logout request via confirmation dialog
test_case_info.pre_condition: A user (Teacher or Student) is successfully logged into the system and is currently on their Dashboard Page. The system is configured to display a confirmation dialog before proceeding with logout.
test_case_info.expected_result: Upon clicking the 'Logout' button, a confirmation dialog appears. When the user clicks 'Cancel' within this dialog, the dialog closes, and the user remains on the Dashboard Page, still logged into the system.
test_case_info.post_condition: The user is still logged into the system and remains on the Dashboard Page, having successfully cancelled the logout action.

test_steps.step: Ensure the user is logged in and navigate to the Dashboard Page.
Click the 'Logout' button in the navigation bar.
Verify that a confirmation dialog (e.g., 'Are you sure you want to log out?') appears on the screen.
Click the 'Cancel' button within the confirmation dialog.
Verify that the confirmation dialog closes and the user remains on the Dashboard Page.
Attempt to access a protected resource to confirm the user is still logged into the system.
